name: GetKeyPairFromKeystore
description: Extracts a key pair and certificate from a Java keystore (ACF compatible).
syntax: GetKeyPairFromKeystore( string keystore, string keystorePassword, string keystoreAlias, [string keypairPassword], [string keystoreType] )

params.name: keypairPassword
params.description: Password for the key entry (defaults to keystorePassword)

params.name: keystoreType
params.description: Keystore type (JKS, PKCS12). Auto-detected if omitted.
